findings.label: Construction-boundary relocation (Option 1)
findings.detail: The design's literal 'construct the session manager offline in build_agent' seam is unachievable: bedrock-agentcore 1.24.1 AgentCoreMemorySessionManager.__init__ performs a live ListEvents read at construction. The coder relocated construction into attach_memory behind a plain-data MemorySessionSpec, preserving the offline-build invariant (unit-asserted with a tripwire). Recorded in task5-verification.md and approved by the parent session as Option 1 (original user message #6). No action required.

Confirmed AgentCoreMemorySessionManager.register_hooks (line 928) and initialize (line 1002) exist; per-turn MessageAddedEvent/AfterInvocationEvent persistence callbacks are installed and asserted by test. This is the revision-2 HIGH fix, correctly implemented.

findings.label: CfnMemory name-pattern fix
findings.detail: Coder found and fixed a real deploy-blocking issue: CfnMemory enforces ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,47}$ (no hyphens), so mahalo-memory was changed to mahalo_memory. Correct fix, documented. Hyphenated WorkloadIdentity/provider names are unaffected.
